basic_info.description: Stunning Historic Loft with Private Patio & Parking in Downtown SF. Experience the perfect blend of historic charm and modern luxury in this exceptional 1-bedroom + office nook loft, set in a National Historic Landmark due to its origins as a railroad warehouse in 1852; the building was converted into live/work lofts in 1996. Featuring soaring ceilings, exposed brick and expansive windows, this home exudes character while offering contemporary updates for effortless city living. The thoughtfully designed layout includes a renovated bathroom, a versatile office nook, and an inviting living space that opens to your own private patio. A rare urban retreat. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and 1-car parking, providing both convenience and comfort. Located within walking distance to the Ferry Building, Oracle Park, the Embarcadero waterfront, top restaurants, and vibrant nightlife, this loft offers an unbeatable location with easy access to everything the city has to offer. 100 transit score.
